name: 複数チームへの所属表示
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0075 compact multiple-team membership display ONLY. Image1 full and image2 crop PRIMARY for original glyph anatomy, proportions, optical stroke and spacing. Image3 Japanese mock secondary for text. One logical164x30 horizontal line, white canvas, no card/border/shadow or extra header.
At left reproduce original SINGLE PERSON inside a thin outlined rounded SQUARE identity/team glyph: a small filled head circle above a compact shoulder/base silhouette, square enclosing frame with modest rounded corners. Do NOT use mock's unframed multiple-person cloud/group icon. Original visible team/identity glyph is authoritative. Slate #526173 fine stroke, approx16px.
To right「技術、企画」exact Japanese text, Meiryo Regular14/24, near-black, no bold, baseline centered with icon, 8px gap. Original full screen dimming is modal context; standalone component on pure white without gray scrim. Restrained compact proportions, adequate blank padding; no green pill, gradient, added avatar or invented controls.
reviewNotes: Original framed single-person/team glyph restored over mock group icon; two-team Japanese label and slate/white compact content inspected. Canvas has generous outer margin; exact font/path/optical stroke and team runtime unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
